Machine Learning.definition: Machine Learning (ML) is a branch of artificial intelligence that enables computers to learn from data and improve performance on tasks without being explicitly programmed.

sutopics.definition: Core mathematical concepts required to understand ML algorithms, including linear algebra, probability, and statistics.

topics.name: Linear Algebra Basics
topics.definition: Vectors, matrices, matrix operations, eigenvalues/eigenvectors, and their role in data representation.

topics.name: Probability Theory
topics.definition: Basic probability, random variables, distributions, Bayes' theorem, and expectation.

topics.name: Descriptive Statistics
topics.definition: Measures of central tendency, variance, covariance, correlation, and data summarization techniques.

sutopics.definition: Essential programming skills and software libraries used to implement ML algorithms.

topics.name: Python Basics
topics.definition: Syntax, data structures, control flow, functions, and modules in Python.

topics.name: NumPy and Pandas
topics.definition: Array manipulation with NumPy and data wrangling with Pandas.

topics.name: Data Visualization with Matplotlib/Seaborn
topics.definition: Creating plots to explore data and communicate results.

topics.name: Introduction to Scikit-learn
topics.definition: Overview of the Scikit-learn API for implementing classic ML models.

sutopics.definition: Fundamental concepts, types of learning, and the typical ML workflow.

topics.name: Types of Machine Learning
topics.definition: Supervised, unsupervised, semi-supervised, and reinforcement learning distinctions.

topics.name: The ML Pipeline
topics.definition: Steps from problem definition, data collection, preprocessing, modeling, evaluation, to deployment.

topics.name: Overfitting and Underfitting
topics.definition: Bias-variance tradeoff, signs of overfitting/underfitting, and intuition behind generalization.

sutopics.definition: Predicting continuous target variables using linear and nonlinear models.

topics.name: Simple Linear Regression
topics.definition: Modeling relationship between one predictor and a response variable using least squares.

topics.name: Multiple Linear Regression
topics.definition: Extending linear regression to multiple predictors, interpretation of coefficients, and multicollinearity.

topics.name: Polynomial Regression
topics.definition: Modeling nonlinear relationships by adding polynomial terms.

topics.name: Regularization (Ridge, Lasso)
topics.definition: Techniques to prevent overfitting by adding penalty terms to the loss function.

sutopics.definition: Predicting discrete class labels using probabilistic and discriminative models.

topics.name: Logistic Regression
topics.definition: Binary classification model using the logistic function to estimate probabilities.

topics.name: K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN)
topics.definition: Instance-based learning that classifies based on majority vote of nearest neighbors.

topics.name: Decision Trees
topics.definition: Tree‑splitting models that partition feature space based on impurity measures.

topics.name: Support Vector Machines (SVM)
topics.definition: Maximum‑margin classifiers that find optimal hyperplanes, with kernel trick for nonlinearity.

topics.name: Naive Bayes
topics.definition: Probabilistic classifier based on Bayes theorem with strong independence assumptions.

sutopics.definition: Discovering hidden structure in unlabeled data via clustering, density estimation, and dimensionality reduction.

topics.name: K-Means Clustering
topics.definition: Partitioning data into K clusters by minimizing within‑cluster sum of squares.

topics.name: Hierarchical Clustering
topics.definition: Building a tree of clusters either agglomeratively or divisively.

topics.name: Principal Component Analysis (PCA)
topics.definition: Linear technique that projects data onto orthogonal axes of maximal variance.

topics.name: t‑SNE and UMAP
topics.definition: Nonlinear dimensionality reduction methods for visualizing high‑dimensional data.

topics.name: Gaussian Mixture Models (GMM)
topics.definition: Probabilistic model assuming data are generated from a mixture of several Gaussian distributions.

sutopics.definition: Techniques to assess model performance, avoid overfitting, and select hyperparameters.

topics.name: Train/Test Split
topics.definition: Dividing data into separate subsets for training and unbiased evaluation.

topics.name: Cross‑Validation
topics.definition: Repeated train/test splits (e.g., k‑fold) to obtain more reliable performance estimates.

topics.name: Metrics for Regression
topics.definition: MAE, MSE, RMSE, R‑squared, and when to use each.

topics.name: Metrics for Classification
topics.definition: Accuracy, precision, recall, F1‑score, ROC‑AUC, and confusion matrix interpretation.

topics.name: Bias‑Variance Tradeoff
topics.definition: Understanding how model complexity affects prediction error and how to balance it.

sutopics.definition: Creating, selecting, and transforming input variables to improve model performance.

topics.name: Handling Missing Data
topics.definition: Techniques such as imputation, deletion, and flagging missing values.

topics.name: Encoding Categorical Variables
topics.definition: One‑hot, ordinal, target, and frequency encoding methods.

topics.name: Scaling and Normalization
topics.definition: Standardization, min‑max scaling, and robust scaling to bring features to comparable ranges.

topics.name: Feature Selection
topics.definition: Filter, wrapper, and embedded methods to identify the most predictive subset of features.

topics.name: Dimensionality Reduction (PCA, LDA)
topics.definition: Techniques to reduce number of features while preserving variance or class separability.

sutopics.definition: Combining multiple models to improve predictive performance and robustness.

topics.name: Bagging and Random Forests
topics.definition: Bootstrap aggregation of decision trees to reduce variance.

topics.name: Boosting (AdaBoost, Gradient Boosting)
topics.definition: Sequential learning where each model corrects errors of its predecessor.

topics.name: XGBoost and LightGBM
topics.definition: Optimized gradient boosting libraries with regularization and handling of sparse data.

topics.name: Stacking and Blending
topics.definition: Meta‑learning approach where predictions of base models are fed into a second‑level model.

sutopics.subtopic_name: Neural Networks and Deep Learning Basics
sutopics.definition: Introduction to artificial neural networks, activation functions, and training via backpropagation.

topics.name: Perceptron and Multilayer Perceptron (MLP)
topics.definition: Simple linear classifier and its extension to multiple hidden layers.

topics.name: Activation Functions
topics.definition: ReLU, sigmoid, tanh, softmax, and their impact on gradient flow.

topics.name: Loss Functions and Optimization
topics.definition: Cross‑entropy, MSE, and optimizers like SGD, Adam, RMSprop.

topics.name: Backpropagation
topics.definition: Algorithm for computing gradients of loss with respect to weights in a multilayer network.

topics.name: Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) – Intro
topics.definition: Neural nets with convolutional layers for processing grid‑like data such as images.

topics.name: Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) – Intro
topics.definition: Networks with recurrent connections for sequential data like text or time series.

sutopics.definition: Taking a trained model to production, ensuring scalability, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

topics.name: Model Serialization
topics.definition: Saving models using pickle, joblib, ONNX, or TensorFlow SavedModel for later reuse.

topics.name: REST API with Flask/FastAPI
topics.definition: Creating a lightweight HTTP service to serve predictions.

topics.name: Containerization with Docker
topics.definition: Packaging the service and its dependencies into a portable container.

topics.name: CI/CD for ML
topics.definition: Automating testing, building, and deployment of ML pipelines using tools like GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Kubeflow Pipelines.

topics.name: Model Monitoring and Drift Detection
topics.definition: Tracking prediction performance, data distribution changes, and setting up alerts.

sutopics.definition: Cutting‑edge areas that build on core ML knowledge, including reinforcement learning, generative models, and meta‑learning.

topics.name: Reinforcement Learning Basics
topics.definition: Agent‑environment interaction, reward signals, value functions, and policy optimization.

topics.name: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs)
topics.definition: Framework where a generator and discriminator compete to produce realistic synthetic data.

topics.name: Variational Autoencoders (VAEs)
topics.definition: Probabilistic autoencoders that learn a latent distribution for data generation.

topics.name: Transfer Learning and Fine‑tuning
topics.definition: Reusing pretrained models on new tasks, adapting layers, and domain adaptation techniques.

topics.name: Meta‑Learning (Learning to Learn)
topics.definition: Algorithms that improve their learning process across multiple tasks, e.g., MAML, Reptile.

Convolution Nueral Network.definition: A deep learning architecture specialized for processing grid-like data such as images, using convolutional operations to extract hierarchical features.

sutopics.definition: Understanding basic neural network concepts, including perceptrons, activation functions, and gradient descent.

topics.name: Perceptrons and Feedforward Networks
topics.definition: Introduction to single-layer and multi-layer perceptrons, linear algebra basics for neural networks.

topics.name: Activation Functions
topics.definition: Sigmoid, tanh, ReLU, and their role in introducing non-linearity to neural networks.

topics.name: Backpropagation Algorithm
topics.definition: Chain rule application in neural networks, gradient calculation, and weight updates during training.

sutopics.definition: Fundamental concepts in digital image representation and preprocessing for computer vision tasks.

topics.name: Pixel Representation
topics.definition: Understanding pixels, bit depth, grayscale vs. color images, and coordinate systems.

topics.name: Image Transformations
topics.definition: Basic image operations: rotation, scaling, translation, and cropping for data augmentation.

sutopics.definition: Core components of CNNs, including filters, kernels, feature maps, and stride/padding parameters.

topics.name: Convolution Operation
topics.definition: Mathematical foundation of convolution, kernel sliding over input, and feature extraction principles.

topics.name: Filters and Feature Maps
topics.definition: Role of learnable filters in detecting patterns, multiple filter channels, and hierarchical feature learning.

topics.name: Stride and Padding
topics.definition: Sliding window parameters, output size calculations, and their impact on receptive field.

sutopics.definition: Dimensionality reduction techniques in CNNs, focusing on downsampling operations and translation invariance.

topics.name: Max Pooling
topics.definition: Selecting maximum values from subregions, reducing spatial dimensions while preserving important features.

topics.name: Average Pooling
topics.definition: Averaging values in local regions, alternative to max pooling with smoother outputs.

sutopics.definition: Transition from convolutional layers to dense layers, final classification stages, and gradient flow optimization.

topics.name: Flattening and Dense Connections
topics.definition: Transforming 3D feature maps into 1D vectors for input into fully connected layers.

topics.name: LeNet Architecture
topics.definition: First practical CNN architecture for handwritten digit recognition, serving as foundational example.

sutopics.definition: Modern innovations to improve CNN performance, including regularization, normalization, and optimization methods.

topics.name: Dropout Regularization
topics.definition: Random unit deactivation during training to prevent overfitting, model ensemble effect.

topics.name: Batch Normalization
topics.definition: Normalizing layer inputs to accelerate training, reduce internal covariate shift, and improve generalization.

topics.name: Residual Connections
topics.definition: Skip connections in deep networks (e.g., ResNet) to address vanishing gradients and enable training of deeper models.

sutopics.definition: Leveraging knowledge from pre-trained models on large datasets (e.g., ImageNet) for new tasks with limited data.

topics.name: Fine-Tuning Pretrained Models
topics.definition: Freezing early layers and retraining top layers for new datasets, balancing feature reuse and adaptation.

topics.name: Popular Architectures
topics.definition: Overview of VGG, Inception, ResNet, and DenseNet architectures, their strengths and applications.

sutopics.definition: Advanced applications of CNNs for identifying and localizing objects in images or segments at pixel level.

topics.name: R-CNN Family
topics.definition: Region proposal networks, Fast R-CNN, Faster R-CNN for joint object detection and classification.

topics.name: YOLO and Retinanet
topics.definition: You Only Look Once for real-time detection and RetinaNet for handling class imbalance in object detection.

sutopics.definition: Practical aspects of deploying CNNs to production environments, including optimization and hardware adaptation.

topics.name: Model Optimization
topics.definition: Quantization, pruning, and knowledge distillation for reducing model size without significant accuracy loss.

topics.name: Hardware Acceleration
topics.definition: Utilizing specialized hardware like GPUs, TPUs, and edge devices for efficient CNN inference.

Indian Medival history.definition: Indian Medieval History covers the period from the decline of the Gupta Empire and the rise of regional kingdoms around the 8th century CE to the fall of the Mughal Empire in the 18th century CE, marking significant political, cultural, and socio-economic transformations.

subtopics.definition: This era marks the rise of powerful regional dynasties across North and South India, characterising political decentralization, feudalism, and rich temple architecture development.

topics.name: Tripartite Struggle and North Indian Kingdoms
topics.definition: Explores the prolonged conflict between the Palas, Pratiharas, and Rashtrakutas for control over the strategic region of Kannauj.

topics.name: The Chola Dynasty and South Indian Kingdoms
topics.definition: Covers the maritime expansion, local self-governance, imperial administration, and grand Dravidian temple architecture of the imperial Cholas.

subtopics.definition: Focuses on the establishment and administration of Islamic rule in Northern India under five distinct dynasties leading up to the Mughal entry.

topics.name: Slave and Khilji Dynasties
topics.definition: Examines the foundation by Qutb-ud-din Aibak, consolidation under Iltutmish and Balban, and market reforms alongside Southern expeditions of Alauddin Khilji.

topics.name: Tughlaq, Sayyid, and Lodi Dynasties
topics.definition: Covers Muhammad bin Tughlaq's controversial policies, Firuz Shah Tughlaq's welfare administrative works, the decline after Timur's invasion, and the final Lodi dynasty.

subtopics.subtopic_name: Regional Kingdoms: Vijayanagara and Bahmani Empires
subtopics.definition: Detailed study of Southern and Central Indian polities that flourished alongside the Delhi Sultanate, fostering regional art, trade, and defense networks.

topics.name: The Vijayanagara Empire
topics.definition: Studies the establishment by Harihara and Bukka, Krishnadevaraya's golden age, Nayankara system, and artistic legacy centered in Hampi.

topics.name: The Bahmani Sultanate and Deccan Sultanates
topics.definition: Covers the rise of the Bahmani kingdom, Mahmud Gawan's reforms, and its eventual fragmentation into the five Deccan Sultanates.

subtopics.definition: Analyzes the rise, consolidation, grand expansion, socio-religious policies, and administrative mechanisms of the premier empire of early modern India.

topics.name: Foundations: Babur, Humayun, and Sher Shah Suri
topics.definition: Examines the First Battle of Panipat, early Mughal struggles, and the administrative tax and road infrastructure established by Sher Shah Suri.

topics.name: Consolidation under Akbar and Administrative Systems
topics.definition: Focuses on Mansabdari and Jagirdari systems, revenue reforms of Todar Mal, religious initiatives like Din-i-Ilahi, and territorial expansion.

topics.name: Peak and Decline: Jahangir, Shah Jahan, and Aurangzeb
topics.definition: Explores artistic achievements, structural monuments like the Taj Mahal, the expensive Deccan Campaigns, religious policies, and factors leading to empire decline.

subtopics.definition: Examines the major socio-religious reform movements that promoted devotion, egalitarian values, vernacular literature, and syncretic cultural traditions across India.

topics.name: The Bhakti Movement
topics.definition: Covers the Nirguna and Saguna traditions led by saints like Kabir, Guru Nanak, Mirabai, Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, and Ramananda.

topics.name: The Sufi Movement
topics.definition: Focuses on Sufi orders (Silsilas) such as Chishti and Suhrawardi, highlighting figures like Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti and Nizamuddin Auliya and their socio-cultural impacts.
